anya: quick canary note — bringing up a new int8 encoder; seeing a rise in funcall JSON parse fails
anya: parse_fail ~2.0% on canary vs 0.1% baseline :eyes:
mike: any raw tails?
anya: sample tail: INVOKE_RESP: {...} <trailing NUL>
mike: trailing NUL will break strict parser
sam: hypothesis: quantization changed tokenizer alignment so streaming boundaries sometimes include control bytes
lia: plan: 1) deploy sanitizer to strip control bytes to 10% canary 2) run token-diff between int8 and fp16 3) micro-quant sweep (per-channel vs global scales)
ci-bot: build 2026-03-24T20:10Z deployed to canary
anya: sanitizer rolled to 10% — parse_fail in sanitized cohort dropped to 0.4%
mike: good mitigation. sam will run the sweep; lia will add schema telemetry to record repair actions
sam: setting up sweep matrix now, will include kvprefix length and temperature as covariates
lia: adding strict-schema probe and dashboard alert if parse_fail_rate > 1% sustained 15m
anya: filed RED-ML-1301 with repro samples and s3 links; owners: anya (mitigation), sam (quant sweep), lia (telemetry)
anya: next check-in 24h or earlier if regression worsens
